# go-modern-slices-reverse

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.Reverse instead of a manual swap loop.

## Details

slices.Reverse performs an in-place reversal without hand-written index math.
It is clearer and less error-prone than open-coded swap loops.

## Examples

### Before

```go
for i, j := 0, len(items)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
  items[i], items[j] = items[j], items[i]
}
```

### After

```go
slices.Reverse(items)
```
